data.action: 手持巨型斩首机械镰刀警戒站立
data.description: 【羽毛笔 · 镰刃夜巡】深夜阴暗潮湿的街巷角落，羽毛笔单手扛着比自己还要巨大的多索雷斯重型机械斩首镰刀警戒伫立。微风吹动她银蓝色的短发与头顶可爱的羽毛发饰，眼神瞬间褪去困意变得锐利——「虽然平时很想睡觉……但如果有敌人敢靠近博士，这把镰刀可是一下子就能把他们切断的。」
data.lighting: dramatic neon rim light, cool blue and magenta street glow
data.promptProse: La Pluma stands alert in a damp Dossoles alley at midnight, supporting her enormous mechanical scythe with one hand at her shoulder. A low full-body view follows the pavement between narrow building walls. Her cropped top, shorts and jacket retain their black and gray colors; cyan street glow outlines the blade, magenta catches her feathered hair, and both colors trail through shallow reflections below.
data.title: 羽毛笔 · 镰刃夜巡
